<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  // ==========================================
  // 1. FORMULARIO Y CONFIGURACIÓN
  // ==========================================

  const form = document.querySelector(
    'form.elementor-form[name="Request Information"]'
  );

  if (!form) {
    console.error("SABER: Formulario no encontrado.");
    return;
  }

  const API_URL = "https://api.verityiq.com/api/leadpost";

  const TEST_MODE = false;

  const THANK_YOU_URL = "/thank-you/";

  const CONFIG = {
    veritySysKey: "vliffv08",
    tenantid: "85",
    schoolname: "Saber College",
    campus: "Miami",
    campaignname: "Request Info Website",
    pub_id: "Saber",
    CPL: "Saber"
  };

  const getField = (id) =>
    form.querySelector("#form-field-" + id);

  const getValue = (id) =>
    (getField(id)?.value || "").trim();

  const params = new URLSearchParams(
    window.location.search
  );

  // ==========================================
  // 2. FUNCIONES AUXILIARES
  // ==========================================

  function normalizePhone(value) {
    let digits = value.replace(/\D/g, "");

    if (
      digits.length === 11 &&
      digits.startsWith("1")
    ) {
      digits = digits.slice(1);
    }

    return digits;
  }

  function generateLeadId() {
    if (window.crypto && crypto.randomUUID) {
      return "M" + crypto.randomUUID();
    }

    return "M" + Date.now().toString();
  }

  function getCampaign() {
    const source = (
      params.get("utm_source") || ""
    ).toLowerCase();

    const medium = (
      params.get("utm_medium") || ""
    ).toLowerCase();

    const isPaid =
      ["cpc", "ppc", "paid", "paid_search"].includes(medium) ||
      ["google_ads", "googleads"].includes(source);

    return {
      campaigntype: isPaid
        ? "Paid Search"
        : "Organic SEO",

      campaigncode: isPaid
        ? "Google Ads Landing Page"
        : "Request Info Website",

      leadsource: isPaid
        ? "Google"
        : "Website"
    };
  }

  // ==========================================
  // 3. CONSTRUIR DATOS DEL LEAD
  // ==========================================

  function createLead() {
    const campaign = getCampaign();

    const lead = {
      ...CONFIG,

      campaigntype: campaign.campaigntype,
      campaigncode: campaign.campaigncode,
      leadsource: campaign.leadsource,

      leadid: generateLeadId(),

      fname: getValue("fname"),
      lname: getValue("lname"),
      email: getValue("email"),

      phone: normalizePhone(
        getValue("phone")
      ),

      address: getValue("street"),
      city: getValue("city"),
      zip: getValue("zip"),

      program: getValue("program"),

      consent: "yes"
    };

    // Agregar parámetros de seguimiento
    [
      "utm_source",
      "utm_medium",
      "utm_campaign",
      "utm_content",
      "utm_term",
      "utm_device",
      "utm_matchtype",
      "Code_Id",
      "adposition",
      "creative_id",
      "network",
      "gclid",
      "fbclid"
    ].forEach((key) => {
      const value = params.get(key);

      if (value) {
        lead[key] = value;
      }
    });

    return lead;
  }

  // ==========================================
  // 4. VALIDACIONES
  // ==========================================

  function validateLead(lead) {

    if (!lead.fname || !lead.lname) {
      throw new Error(
        "Please enter your full name."
      );
    }

    if (
      !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(
        lead.email
      )
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Please enter a valid email address."
      );
    }

    if (
      !/^[2-9]\d{2}[2-9]\d{6}$/.test(
        lead.phone
      )
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Please enter a valid US phone number."
      );
    }

    if (!lead.program) {
      throw new Error(
        "Please select a program."
      );
    }

  }

  // ==========================================
  // 5. LIMPIAR FORMULARIO
  // ==========================================

  function clearForm() {

    form.reset();

    // Limpiar campos visibles.
    [
      "fname",
      "lname",
      "email",
      "phone"
    ].forEach((id) => {
      const input = getField(id);

      if (input) {
        input.value = "";
      }
    });

    // Mantener program y campus porque son
    // campos ocultos configurados en Elementor.

    // Actualizar intl-tel-input si está disponible.
    const phoneInput = getField("phone");

    if (
      phoneInput &&
      window.intlTelInput &&
      typeof window.intlTelInput.getInstance === "function"
    ) {
      const instance =
        window.intlTelInput.getInstance(phoneInput);

      if (instance) {
        instance.setNumber("");
      }
    }
  }

  // ==========================================
  // 6. ENVÍO A VERITY IQ
  // ==========================================

  let submitting = false;

  form.addEventListener("submit", async function (event) {

    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopImmediatePropagation();

    if (submitting) return;

    const button = form.querySelector(
      '[type="submit"]'
    );

    try {

      const lead = createLead();

      validateLead(lead);

      if (TEST_MODE) {
        console.table(lead);

        alert(
          "Test mode: no lead was sent."
        );

        return;
      }

      submitting = true;

      if (button) {
        button.disabled = true;
      }

      // Enviar datos a Verity IQ
      const response = await fetch(API_URL, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type":
            "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
        },
        body: new URLSearchParams(lead).toString()
      });

      const result = await response.text();

      console.log(
        "VERITY HTTP STATUS:",
        response.status
      );

      console.log(
        "VERITY RESPONSE:",
        result
      );

      // Validar respuesta HTTP
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          "Verity IQ HTTP error: " +
          response.status
        );
      }

      // Verity puede devolver "success" como texto
      // o como cadena JSON.
      let parsedResult = result;

      try {
        parsedResult = JSON.parse(result);
      } catch (e) {
        // La respuesta no es JSON.
      }

      const isSuccess =
        typeof parsedResult === "string" &&
        parsedResult.trim().toLowerCase() === "success";

      if (!isSuccess) {
        throw new Error(
          "Verity IQ did not confirm success."
        );
      }

      // ======================================
      // 7. ENVÍO EXITOSO
      // ======================================

      console.log(
        "SABER: Lead enviado correctamente."
      );

      // Evento de conversión para GTM.
      if (window.dataLayer) {
        window.dataLayer.push({
          event: "formSubmission",
          formName: "formProfessionalNursing",
          formCampus: lead.campus,
          formProgram: lead.program,
          leadId: lead.leadid,

          utm_source: lead.utm_source || "",
          utm_medium: lead.utm_medium || "",
          utm_campaign: lead.utm_campaign || ""
        });
      }

      // Limpiar los campos del formulario.
      clearForm();

      // Redireccionar a la página de gracias.
      window.location.assign(THANK_YOU_URL);

    } catch (error) {

      console.error(
        "SABER VERITY ERROR:",
        error
      );

      alert(
        "We couldn't process your request. " +
        "Please try again."
      );

    } finally {

      submitting = false;

      if (button) {
        button.disabled = false;
      }

    }

  }, true);

});
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const input = document.querySelector("#form-field-phone");

  if (!input) return;

  /*
   * Bloquea escritura manual de indicativos distintos a +1
   * Ejemplo bloqueado: +57, +52, +34, +44
   */
  input.addEventListener("input", function () {
    const value = input.value.trim();

    if (value.startsWith("+") && !value.startsWith("+1")) {
      input.value = "+1";
    }
  });

  /*
   * Bloquea pegado de indicativos distintos a +1
   */
  input.addEventListener("paste", function (event) {
    const pastedText = (event.clipboardData || window.clipboardData)
      .getData("text")
      .trim();

    if (pastedText.startsWith("+") && !pastedText.startsWith("+1")) {
      event.preventDefault();
      input.value = "+1";
      alert("Only US phone numbers starting with +1 are allowed.");
    }
  });

});
</script>

settings.title: Professional Nursing A.S. Degree Program Overview

settings.editor:
The Associate of Science in Nursing at SABER College provides students
with a strong foundation in nursing knowledge, clinical skills, and patient
care. The program combines classroom instruction, lab training, and supervised
clinical practice to prepare students for real healthcare environments.
Graduates are prepared to sit for the NCLEX-RN, building the skills, confidence,
and professional readiness needed for a career in nursing.

settings.title: Why Choose the Professional Nursing A.S. Program at SABER College?

settings.editor: Comprehensive nursing education integrating theory, lab, and clinical practice
Structured learning through classroom, lab, and clinical environments
Real-world clinical experience in supervised healthcare settings
Focused development of clinical judgment and patient-centered care
Program designed to prepare graduates for the NCLEX-RN
Professional training for real responsibility in healthcare environments

settings.title: What You Will Learn in the Professional Nursing Program

settings.editor: You’ll develop the clinical knowledge, technical skills, and professional judgment needed to deliver safe, effective nursing care in real healthcare environments.

• Anatomy & Physiology
  • Fundamentals of Nursing
  • Pharmacology
  • Pathophysiology
  • Nursing ethics and patient safety

• Patient assessment and monitoring
  • Vital signs and health evaluation
  • Medication administration
  • Infection control and safety procedures
  • Therapeutic communication
  • Clinical decision-making
  • Basic and advanced patient care techniques

• Supervised clinical training in healthcare settings
  • Hands-on patient care experience
  • Application of nursing theory in real scenarios
  • Development of professional nursing responsibility

The program is designed to prepare graduates to sit for the
NCLEX-RN, supporting the transition from student to licensed nursing professional.
80 Credits | 1,725 Clock Hours

The Professional Nursing Program (PNP) at SABER College is an
intensive, full-time program that integrates theory, lab training,
and supervised clinical rotation experience.

• Medical-Surgical Nursing
  • Obstetric-Gynecologic Nursing
  • Pediatric Nursing
  • Gerontologic Nursing
  • Psychiatric Nursing

• Nursing theory instruction
  • Hands-on laboratory training
  • Supervised clinical rotations
  • Patient-centered care practice
  • Clinical skill development
  • Professional nursing preparation

Students complete supervised clinical rotations in real healthcare
settings, applying nursing theory and lab training in real patient
care environments across multiple areas of practice.

Professional nurses play a critical role in healthcare systems across
the U.S., supporting patient care, clinical operations, and community
health in a wide range of healthcare environments.
Possible Career Paths:

• Registered Nurse (RN)
  • Clinical Nurse
  • Patient Care Nurse
  • Hospital Nurse
  • Community Health Nurse
  • Long-Term Care Nurse

Professional nurses work in hospitals, healthcare facilities, long-term
care centers, outpatient settings, and community health environments.
Graduates may pursue opportunities across multiple areas of patient
care and continue their professional development within the
healthcare field.

• High school diploma, GED, or equivalent
  • Personal oral and written interview with the Nursing Program Team
  • Official transcripts required
  • Criminal background check
  • Drug screening
  • Physical health requirements for clinical training
  • CPR certification (American Heart Association)
Our admissions team provides personalized support through every step.
